correctness.rationale: Encode Petersen vertices by disjoint 2-subsets of five symbols and Petersen edges by unused symbol plus pairing of the other four. Independent reconstruction of the 15-vertex line graph gives among 105 unordered vertex pairs exactly 30 distance 1, 60 distance 2, and 15 distance 3; distance-three edges form exactly five disjoint 3-vertex fiber cliques. Hence the threshold-two complex is a join of five three-point discrete sets, whose reduced integral homology is Z^32 in degree four (and wedge of 32 S4). The scale-one triangle-star cover has nerve Petersen, H1=Z^6. At threshold three the full simplex occurs. S5 permutes fiber factors with the Koszul sign; the tensor trace on each permutation cycle gives degree-four class values (32,0,8,2,0,0,2), degree-one from signed Petersen cellular chains (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1). The complete package verifier's source enumerates all 120 permutations, signed Lefschetz traces and rational Specht multiplicities; the group-theoretic trace formulas and join proof independently support those results. Integral torsion-free homology does not justify integral splitting into rational irreducibles.
residual_risks: The Specht decomposition is over Q only; the proof does not assert integral equivariant splitting.
